name: Tail Eater
description: Snakes eat each other from the tail until only one is left. A calm snake puzzle for Android.
about: Tail Eater is a calm snake puzzle with one simple rule: snakes eat from the tail. Tap a snake and it crawls straight ahead. If the first thing in its way is the tail of another snake, it eats that snake and grows longer. Bump into a wall, a head or a body and you lose a heart. Clear the board until only one snake is left.
play_data: The levels you start, win, restart and leave, your moves, mistakes and hearts, the hints you use, time spent
settings_example: how often ads may be shown
ad_formats: a full-screen ad between levels and, if you choose to watch it, a short video that gives you an extra heart, a hint or double coins
